description: BUNKER V2 single-rigid-body compound-contact plant with an explicit directional track-force law.

measured_fixed.source: BUNKER base_link STL measurements and existing Isaac Sim 5.1 URDF import

reference_only.note: Future calibration reference only; V2 retains the imported mass and inertia.

notes: Every value in tunable_uncalibrated is an initial simulation assumption, not a measured BUNKER parameter.
Low native friction preserves normal support while avoiding substantial double-counting of custom tangential forces.
A zero delay, deadzone, acceleration limit, or maximum track force disables that optional actuator feature.
The initial 250 N per-side force ceiling is an uncalibrated safety guard against impact-normal-load spikes, not an actuator measurement.
cylinders_legacy preserves the original fixed-cylinder support for A/B comparison; those cylinders do not represent real road wheels or belt links.
flat_track_boxes uses one non-overlapping physical support box per side; its 0.020 m thickness is a numerical support assumption, not a measured track thickness.
The five X patch centers remain virtual force/contact-classification bins in both support modes.
support_load_threshold_n is a numerical diagnostic assumption used to distinguish meaningful side support from negligible reported load.
